title: Semilinear Heat Inequalities with a Hardy-Type Potential in an Exterior Geodesic Domain on $\mathbb{S}^N$
summary: We study an inhomogeneous semilinear heat inequality on the unit sphere \(\mathbb S^N\), \(N\ge3\), in an exterior geodesic domain associated with a fixed pole. The equation involves the singular Hardy-type potential \(λ/\sin^2 r\), where \(r=d(o,x)\), and the weighted nonlinearity \((\sin r)^α|u|^p\). For \(α>-2\) and \(0 p_{\mathrm{crit}}\), whereas classical solutions exist for some positive continuous sources in the range \(1 1\).
